text: Yes, the asset has experienced deforestation. The evidence shows that there was a tree-cover loss event in 2021, with an area of 81.3 hectares, which is about 2.23% of the asset. The European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 data corroborates this, indicating that 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020. Additionally, the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries' data shows that the forest type in the event area was primarily planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda.
